posts.title: Rust - Multithreading - ABBA deadlock with Arc, Mutex and OS Thread
posts.description: Your program compiles, runs, prints nothing, and simply sits there forever. Welcome to the deadlock club, the most silent bug family in concurrent programming. In this tutorial we build the most classic deadlock of all, the lock ordering deadlock, also known as the ABBA deadlock. posts.title: Rust - CLI - Validate program arguments and handle errors with an enum and test suite
posts.description: A command line program always starts with the same question: what did the user actually pass in, and can I work with that? In this tutorial we’re going to see how to handle user arguments and how to test them through unit tests and integration tests. What we need GitHub for this tutorial: https://github.com/badprog/badprog-rust-cli-validate-program-arguments-and-handle-errors-with-an-enum-and-test
